text:
Maya: Quick q — thinking about a compact 'compare lanes' UI in console analytics to show per-route vs per-model filters side-by-side. Can we do this without adding too much visual clutter? saved queries + quick toggles + telemetry/quotas concerns.
Kevin: I like lanes. Main infra constraint: avoid fetching full telemetry for both lanes on open. Instead show lightweight summaries and fetch details on demand. Precompute rollups per route/model where possible.
Sam: 100%. Also we need quota/charge awareness. If a user runs a full compare (large range + embeddings) we should warn and maybe require confirmation. Suggest a preview mode that is cheap.
Tess: Preview mode = counts + top diffs, no raw samples. UI idea: small pill to toggle Preview / Full. Preview queries use a lower sample rate, and show estimated cost.
Jordan: From analytics: we can surface an API endpoint: `GET /console/compare?laneA=route:abc&laneB=model:stable&preview=true` which returns summarized metrics + `estimated_cost` and `sample_rate_hint`. That lets UI show quick estimates before full fetch.
Maya: For saved queries — should a saved query capture lane mapping (route/model), filter deltas, column selection, and sampling hint? Also need naming, ownership, and visibility rules.
Kevin: Proposal for saved-query schema (minimal): `{"scope":"console","lanes":[{"type":"route","id":"r-abc"},{"type":"model","id":"m-stable"}],"filters":[...],"sampleRate":0.1,"visibility":"org|personal","owner":"kevin"}`. Backwards-compatible defaults for older queries.
Sam: Ops notes: migrations for older saved queries (missing sampleRate/visibility) will be needed. Also limit concurrent heavy compares per-org — soft queue + explanatory messaging.
Tess: DevEx: quick-compare button on route page, plus keyboard shortcut. Keep header compact so it doesn't push other controls off-screen.
Maya: @Kevin can you sketch a minimal wireframe that shows lanes + preview banner? @Jordan can you add `estimated_tokens` + `sample_hint` to the compare API? I'll draft the preview banner copy.
Kevin: I'll drop a quick mock in #design tomorrow morning.
Jordan: I'll open a telemetry PR to include `estimated_tokens` and `sample_hint` in the API response. ETA EOD.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: branch `compare-lanes-preview` deployed to staging (build 824).
Maya: We should also audit and log when a user switches from Preview -> Full for billing and quota tracking: capture `user`, `saved_query_id` or `ad-hoc`, `estimated_tokens`.
Sam: Agreed. Also add a soft cap: after N concurrent heavy compares queue with position + estimate.
Tess: UX question — where should saved queries live? route page dropdown + global saved modal? I vote both (route quick access + global library).
Maya: Sounds good. Sync tomorrow 10:00am. Action items: Kevin = mock, Jordan = API + telemetry fields, Sam = infra quotas doc + soft queue design, Tess = devex flows + keyboard shortcut, Maya = preview copy + saved-query naming rules.
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Sam: +1
